stories.title: Ritmo Futuro celebra cinco anos de música eletrónica com festa em Faro
stories.summary: The Faro collective Ritmo Futuro marks five years with a party at Art Haus Club on Saturday 28 November, from 23:59 to 05:00 on Sunday. The lineup is Rick Offen, Awk and Trouble. Tickets are sold on Shotgun, and the article describes nights built around the dancefloor and the local community that has grown up around them.

stories.title: PLEASE DO NOT DISTURB: Novo conceito de evento de música eletrónica estreia-se em Lisboa com RIVO
stories.summary: The promoter Sodade is launching a new electronic event concept, 'please do not disturb', with its first edition on 19 December at LX Factory in Lisbon under the motto 'disconnect to connect'. The French DJ/producer RIVO headlines, joined by the Braga duo Mayze x Faria, the French DJ Max Arthur and the Portuguese DJ JÖAH (Soulset). Tickets are on sale via sodade.bol.pt, and the article is based on a press release.

stories.title: Este novo espaço no Porto é restaurante à semana e discoteca ao fim de semana
stories.summary: SYNC, a new venue at Praceta Adelino Amaro da Costa in Porto, works as a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant during the week and turns into a club on Fridays and Saturdays from 23:30, with clubbing until 04:00. It has guest DJs, an area by the DJ booth that becomes a dancefloor, and themed parties through the year. The dining room seats 80.

stories.title: Hard Techno Party Teletech Expects to Sell Close to 500,000 Tickets in 2026
stories.summary: Billboard reports that Teletech, the hard techno party brand founded in Manchester by Anton Stevens and Tom Shelton, expects to sell close to 500,000 tickets in 2026. A five-person team runs it, with events across Europe, South America, Australia and the US, plus its own label, Teletech Records. Next up is Space Miami on 27 November with Adrián Mills, Benwal, Danyelino and Hannah Laing. Its New Year's event, Fresh Start, is at The Warehouse on Pier 80 in San Francisco on 2 January 2027, with Sara Landry, I Hate Models and Nico Moreno and about 20,000 people expected.

stories.title: Português DJ Ride é campeão do Mundo: "Trabalhei imenso durante anos"
stories.summary: Portuguese DJ, producer and sound engineer DJ Ride won the Open category at the 41st DMC World DJ Championships, held at KOKO in London. The article calls DMC the most prestigious international DJ competition, held since 1985, and notes he already holds five world scratch titles and four IDA world titles. He says he trained hard for years, will probably skip competing next year to become a judge, and is working on DJ tools including a competition vinyl, a new album and his work with Beatbombers.

stories.title: Federal Judge Rejects Lowery v. Suno Dismissal Amid NIL Battle
stories.summary: Judge Angel Kelley denied AI music company Suno's motion to dismiss the class action led by Jason Isbell and David Lowery, which alleges name, image and likeness violations across at least 15 states and territories. The amended complaint's plaintiffs include The Chicks and Dirty Projectors, and it argues that Suno's label licensing deals with Warner, Believe and BMG do not cover performers' personal likeness rights. The full order had not been released at press time.

stories.title: The Prodigy cancel Amsterdam and Brussels shows, ending European tour early
stories.summary: The Prodigy cancelled the final two dates of their European tour, Brussels (Forest National, 27 November) and Amsterdam (28 November), on doctors' orders, days after calling off Prague and Vienna due to illness. The band did not say which member is unwell. The ten-date tour began in Oslo on 14 November and was their first proper headline European tour in about three years.

stories.title: UX Arena, a new 40,000-capacity venue, opens in the Tulum jungle on NYE
stories.summary: Universal Xperience, which acquired Zamna earlier this year, will open UX Arena, a 40,000-capacity venue on a former limestone quarry between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, on December 31 with RENAISSANCE Tulum NYE featuring Sasha, Maceo Plex, Sébastien Léger and Ida Engberg. The site has three stages, and UX says no forest will be cleared because it is built on the old quarry. The January season includes Amnesia, Anyma, Black Coffee, Adriatique and Adam Port.

stories.title: Suno: A Reflection of Our Own Lack of Creativity?
stories.summary: An opinion piece by Shana Bize on producers' anxiety about the AI music generator Suno. It cites a 2026 study by David Dalmazzo and colleagues of more than 60,000 tracks (about 20,000 each from Suno, Udio and human composers), which found that Suno output showed more restricted harmonic and structural diversity, an effect the researchers call 'output homogenization'. It notes that producers such as Alan Braxe, Fred Falke and Todd Edwards have used Suno, and argues that artistic intention matters more than simplicity. The piece closes by promoting the outlet's own AI-assisted production service, PURE BPM.
